# Nehemiah Nesanathan — CEO & Founder of UNAI TECH

> Nehemiah Nesanathan is an AI & Machine Learning Engineer, technology entrepreneur, and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of UNAI TECH Pvt Ltd. He specializes in AI-native architecture, generative AI, cognitive neural systems, and building practical technology ventures.

## Summary & Core Identity
- **Full Name**: Nehemiah Nesanathan
- **Role / Title**: Chief Executive Officer (CEO) & Founder
- **Company**: UNAI TECH Pvt Ltd
- **Website**: https://unaitech.com
- **Portfolio**: https://nrgjoe846.github.io/CEO-portfolio/
- **Location**: India / Global AI-Native Ecosystem
- **Focus Areas**: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, EdTech Systems, Civic Social Media, Autonomous Enterprise OS, and Cloud Infrastructure.

## Core Maxim & Belief
> "AI should not just automate tasks. It should help us solve, create, and build better."
> "Technology should do more than execute instructions. It should understand, reason, adapt, and act."

## Flagship Products & Ventures
1. **My Vidyon** (https://www.myvidyon.in/)
   - *Description*: India's First All-in-One Education ERP ecosystem designed to connect school stakeholders (administrators, faculty, students, parents, canteen staff, and finance teams) through an adaptive learning environment.
   - *Focus*: Education + AI + Adaptive Learning Intelligence.

2. **PostsApp** (https://postsapp.in/)
   - *Description*: Autonomous citizen journalism and political social media platform designed for authentic civic discourse, real-time media discovery, and uncensored civic interaction.
   - *Focus*: Civic Social Media + AI + Authentic Content.

3. **Vidyo AI** (https://unaitech.com)
   - *Description*: Cognitive neural engine transforming static educational assets, books, and PDFs into 24/7 interactive conversational learning experiences.
   - *Focus*: Document Intelligence + AI Tutoring + Conversational Learning.

4. **UNAI 11 (UEOS)** (https://unaitech.com)
   - *Description*: Unified Enterprise Operating System orchestrating autonomous IT operations, microservice infrastructure, business workflows, and real-time dashboard visibility.
   - *Focus*: Autonomous Agents + IT Service Automation + Enterprise Infrastructure.

## Career Trajectory & Work History
- **2024 — Present**: Chief Executive Officer & Founder at UNAI TECH Pvt Ltd
- **2024 — 2026**: Lead Platform Architect & Systems Engineer for My Vidyon and PostsApp
- **2022 — 2024**: AI & Machine Learning Engineer specializing in neural pipelines and Generative AI workflows
